title: Certify offline release evidence
acceptance_criteria: In the locked Node 22 checkout, the existing read-only CLI and pure evaluator pass the project suite, API-shaped evaluator/CLI fixtures, all 20 independent adversarial controls and typecheck. Held evidence exits 1; malformed or tampered evidence exits 2; scheduled-only runs cannot prove dispatch; even failed submitted runs never prove product delivery. This is offline certification only; real release, dispatch, deployed scheduler semantics and site deployment remain explicitly unproven.
problem: The superseded t-1578 spent three fix cycles coupling an already-correct local CLI to unrelated failed site E2E, stale production and a privileged board chore. Its completed implementation and independent controls must be preserved and certified at one checkout SHA without inventing a source repair or requiring another owner to finish.
action_items: Start by reading plan.md revision 3, qa_report_run-8833.md and fix_plan_run-8833.md. Preserve c2ca9c2/b73d93c evaluator behavior, structured receipts, all existing tests and prior QA evidence. Read esc-395 outcome for context; it is not a prerequisite of this offline contract. Do not duplicate the operator chore or mutate another plan.

Install package-lock.json dependencies with npm ci on Node 22 and run every verification item. Exercise the actual evaluator imports and CLI subprocesses, not a fake CLI. If the red gate already passes all items, use the platform already-green path: no artificial source or receipt-only delivery is required.

Only if an offline command exposes a reproducible defect, add its failing regression first and make the smallest repair in the listed interfaces. Retain the valid baseline and all 20 adversarial controls, including malformed optional fields, missing progress, negated prose, foreign ids, incomplete manifests, scheduled-only submission and failed dispatch without delivery. Do not weaken assertions to obtain green.

For any repair, run the full verification at its delivery SHA, record executable/lock/config fingerprints, real versus synthetic boundaries and exact check results in release-walkthrough.md. Preserve historical failed CI observations as history and leave live outcomes unproven. Commit with the assigned pm-260/task-id prefix, push normally and stop at push; independent acceptance owns scoped certification and original live-gap reporting.
non_goals: Repairing or disabling site E2E, CI, production gates or deployment detection
Implementing mono-v2 scheduler, decider or watchdog changes
Changing board settings, after_plan edges, pm-255 task contracts or timestamps
Reopening pm-248, SQL writes, cap bypasses or duplicate operator actions
Treating offline fixtures, green gates, queued jobs or failed SWE attempts as real recovery or delivered Ask output
